text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need to bundle the LangChain adaptor + Gateway connector for a single AWS Marketplace listing and prep a joint announcement. Timeline target: two weeks. Thoughts?
Alex Ortiz: +1. We should decouple the marketplace asset (AMI/Container + manifest) from the announcement text. I'll own the listing artifacts. @Jessica can you handle partner marketing copy? :pray:
Jessica (Jess) King: Yep. I can draft the joint blog + short social deck. Need links to integration demo and a 1-paragraph quote from the partner. Can we get that by EOD Wed?
Samir Patel: I'll run the compatibility smoke tests (LangChain pipelines + Gateway auth + routing). Expect to need one hotfix for a header mismatch. Plan: create a small test harness and a perf matrix. ETA 3 days.
Maria Chen: Good. @Samir add results to the repo under /integrations/marketplace/manifest and tag me. Also we need an ops checklist for Dedicated/private deploys so customers know options.
Alex Ortiz: Draft marketplace manifest (minimal):
```
name: redwood-langchain-gateway
version: 1.0.0
artifacts:
  - container: ghcr.io/redwood/langchain-gateway:stable
  - manifest: integrations/marketplace/manifest.yaml
compatibility: ["langchain>=0.35","gateway>=2.1"]
```
I'll push an initial PR today.
Liam O'Donnell: Legal/partner ops: I'll schedule a 30-min contract sync with the gateway team on Thursday morning. Also need to confirm co-marketing approval window (usually 5 business days).
Jessica (Jess) King: For the announcement, propose: 1) joint blog, 2) short how-to video (90s), 3) Marketplace listing + hands-on quickstart. I'll draft calendar with deadlines.
Samir Patel: Note: for routing fallback we need to document behavior when gateway rate-limits — suggest explicit fallback to a smaller model variant in the listing docs. I'll add a short note to the README.
Maria Chen: Action items round-up: Alex = marketplace artifacts + PR (due in 48h). Samir = test harness + README note (72h). Jess = announce drafts + video script (5 days). Liam = partner legal sync + co-marketing signoff (by end of week). I'll coordinate release date once legal confirms.
Alex Ortiz: Ping me if you need sample metrics to include in the listing (latency/cost numbers). I can export token-level breakdown from Console.
gateway-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered for branch feature/marketplace-bundle (build started).
Jessica (Jess) King: Thanks — I'll slot draft blog for review on Monday. :rocket:
Maria Chen: Perfect. If anything blocks, add to this thread. Otherwise we reconvene after Samir's tests land. :thumbsup:
